entry.description: Introduce the `log4j-trustgate` module with fail-closed input validation for configuration parsing paths. TrustGate provides `DefaultInputSanitizer` and built-in `ValidationRule` implementations for JNDI scheme blocking, URI scheme allowlists, lookup patterns, recursive lookup depth limits, and property key validation. Configure strictness via `log4j2.trustgate.strictness` (`STRICT`, `PERMISSIVE`, `DISABLED`; default `STRICT`).
